description: One entry per (binary system, phase). Structure types are assigned only when certain (tier A: standard phase name; tier B: unique MP+OQMD on-hull match; tier C: one structure stated by the assessment's crystallographic table, assessor-stated); otherwise candidates are listed and the phase is marked needs_review. Field reference: SCHEMA.md.
id_rule: phase:<sorted lower-case elements>:<slug>, the SGTE-corpus canonical id convention
stability_rule: calculated diagrams: pycalphad 0.11.2, 300-2500 K unless calc_T_range_K is given, 1 atm, 0.01 composition grid (orchid-data phase-diagrams/sgte)
